title: Banana Orange and Date Health Loaf
ingredients: 2 c flour (whole wheat) + 3 tsp baking powder
raw_text:
Banana Orange and Date Health Loaf
90g. butter
2 tsp. grated orange peel
1/3 c. sugar
2 eggs
1 c. mashed bananas
3/4 c. chopped dates
2c. flour (whole wheat) + 3 tsp baking powder    (over)
1/2 c. + 2 tbsp orange juice

title: Banana Orange and Date Health Loaf
directions: Grease a loaf pan & line with waxed paper.
Cream butter, rind & sugar in small bowl with electric mixer until light and fluffy, beat in eggs one at a time, add banana, beat until combined.
Transfer mixture to a larger bowl, stir in dates, then half the flour & half the orange juice; then stir in remaining flour & orange juice; stir until smooth.
Spread mixture into prepared pan.
Bake in mod. oven for about 1 hr. Stand 5 mins before turning onto rack to cool.

title: Flapper Pie
attribution: Marge Horning (newspaper column; recipe her mother used, sent in for Nel Kirby)
directions: Crust: Mix well and line a 9-inch pie plate, save 1 tablespoon of crumbs for meringue topping. Brown for 8 minutes at 375°F.
Filling: Cook until thick. Pour hot into crust.
Meringue: Beat until stiff.

Pour meringue on warm pie, making sure the meringue is covering all sides of the crust so the meringue doesn't shrink. Sprinkle fine crumbs over the top. Bake at 250°F for 20 minutes, or until meringue is golden brown,
notes: Thanks to the many readers who have sent in the flapper pie recipe for Nel Kirby, the response was overwhelming. Marge Horning sends along the recipe her mother used.
Clipping is cut off at bottom mid-sentence
raw_text:
FLAPPER PIE
Thanks to the many readers who have sent in the flapper pie recipe for Nel Kirby, the response was overwhelming. Marge Horning sends along the recipe her mother used.

Crust:
14 double graham wafers, ground fine
1/2 cup white sugar
1/4 cup melted margarine (or butter)
1 tsp. cinnamon
Mix well and line a 9-inch pie plate, save 1 tablespoon of crumbs for meringue topping. Brown for 8 minutes at 375°F.

Filling:
2 cups milk
2 egg yolks
1 tsp vanilla
2 tbsp cornstarch
1/4 cup sugar
Cook until thick. Pour hot into crust.

Meringue:
2 egg whites
3 tbsp icing sugar
1/8 tsp cream of tartar

Beat until stiff.

Pour meringue on warm pie, making sure the meringue is covering all sides of the crust so the meringue doesn't shrink. Sprinkle fine crumbs over the top. Bake at 250°F for 20 minutes, or until meringue is golden brown,
